item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Meher looks at the diagram of quadrilateral $ABCD$. All four sides carry the same tick mark. No right-angle mark is shown.

Which claim correctly classifies $ABCD$?

options.A: $ABCD$ is a rhombus and a parallelogram; it is not a square because no right angle is shown.
options.B: Call $ABCD$ a rhombus while the four sides are allowed to be unequal.
options.C: Being a parallelogram is what creates the four equal side lengths.
options.D: Call $ABCD$ a square under the same marks, with right angles that are not shown.
